# The output uses tab-separated (row, col): value format on each line
# Let me parse it properly
import re

lines = excel_output.strip().split('\n')
cells = {}
for line in lines:
    # Each line may contain multiple (row, col): value entries separated by tabs
    entries = re.findall(r'\((\d+),\s*(\d+)\):\s*([^\t]*)', line)
    for row_s, col_s, val in entries:
        cells[(int(row_s), int(col_s))] = val.strip()

print(f"Total cells parsed: {len(cells)}")

if cells:
    max_col = max(c for (r, c) in cells.keys())
    max_row = max(r for (r, c) in cells.keys())
    headers = [cells.get((1, c), '') for c in range(1, max_col + 1)]
    print(f"Rows: {max_row}, Cols: {max_col}")
    print(f"Headers: {headers}")

    # Find ORD-6C71B1
    target = "ORD-6C71B1"
    order_row = None
    for r in range(2, max_row + 1):
        if cells.get((r, 1), '') == target:
            order_row = r
            break

    if order_row:
        print(f"\n===== Order Details for {target} (Row {order_row}) =====")
        for c in range(1, max_col + 1):
            print(f"  {headers[c-1]}: {cells.get((order_row, c), '')}")
    else:
        # Print all order IDs to see what's available
        all_order_ids = [cells.get((r, 1), '') for r in range(2, max_row + 1)]
        print(f"\nOrder {target} not found. All Order IDs: {all_order_ids}")
